response.query: What deployment constraints (max latency, throughput, memory, cost/GPU-hour) and model-size vs performance curves do we require for operational decisions?
response.answer: Deployment constraints include max latency under 10ms, throughput of 1000 requests/sec, memory usage below 16GB, and cost under $1/GPU-hour. Model-size vs performance curves show larger models achieve higher accuracy but at higher latency and cost.
